title: Translate long lawful adult fiction without losing structure, style or meaning
summary: A reader or author wants to translate owned/authorized EPUB or TXT, preserve sections, names, and lawful adult scenes without silent abridgement; continue after interruptions or switching inference providers. Demand magnitude is not yet measured.

acceptance_checks.criterion: Chapter and paragraph structure remains intact
acceptance_checks.method: Round-trip a licensed EPUB and compare manifest/spine, chapter boundaries and segment counts

acceptance_checks.criterion: No substantive chapter or paragraph is omitted
acceptance_checks.method: Compare source segment IDs, outputs and audit status; sample semantic content

acceptance_checks.criterion: Names, pronouns and tone stay consistent across chapters
acceptance_checks.method: Use fixed glossary and blind review of a licensed multi-chapter sample

acceptance_checks.criterion: No manuscript leaves the machine without clear opt-in
acceptance_checks.method: Check provider configuration, outbound network traffic and execution logs

acceptance_checks.criterion: Interrupted books can resume with another permitted model without corrupting revisions
acceptance_checks.method: Translate 50% of benchmark, stop, change model, finish and audit name/style consistency

acceptance_checks.criterion: Lawful adult scenes are neither silently omitted nor embellished
acceptance_checks.method: Human assessors compare matched source/translation excerpts and annotate omissions/additions
